title: THIS is How Leif Soreide Finds 90%+ Winners (High Tight Flags and More)
description:
🚩Learn to trade High Tight Flags from Leif Soreide, the 2019 U.S. Investing Champion. He shares his step-by-step process for finding these high-growth stocks before they skyrocket!
https://go.traderlion.com/uinlA

Discover how Leif Soreide finds stocks with a 90%+ win rate using High-Tight Flags (HTFs) and explosive momentum setups. In this in-depth session, Leif breaks down how to spot early-stage leaders, manage risk, and enter with conviction. Learn why tight consolidations, volume contractions, and institutional accumulation are critical for catching the biggest stock moves before they happen. Leif also shares real trade examples, IPO strategies, and tips for maximizing winners while minimizing losses.

Key Topics Covered:
✅ How High-Tight Flags signal explosive stock moves
✅ Why volume contraction and tight price action indicate institutional buying
✅ How to find the strongest stocks using relative strength and market conditions
✅ Entry and exit strategies to capitalize on fast-moving stocks
✅ How to adapt to different market cycles and avoid false breakouts

Enjoy!

- The TraderLion Team
